transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi there! Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light gardening after 1 week. Please avoid heavy work, lifting heavy objects, and strenuous exercise for a month. 

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more. 

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s helpful to know, thank you. Another thing I’m wondering about is that I’m very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some sensitivity to light can be normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter than you’re used to, wear sunglasses when you go outside. But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if your eye is also red and painful, and we may need to assess this further. 

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm sorry to interrupt, but should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay.

Also, I was saying that severe light sensitivity is not normal, especially if your eye is red and painful, and we may need to assess this further. If it’s just mild brightness, sunglasses outside are fine.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I think that covers everything. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thanks again for your assistance!
